QuestInfo.name: [Silent Crusade] Checking Ito
QuestInfo.0: Go check on Ito for Crow.
QuestInfo.2: Ito has been feeling strange since he went past the Mystic Gate. He has been anxious, irritable, and totally out of energy. Go tell Crow what you've learned.

0.0: Hi. I'm...oh, I'm so tired. So very tired.\r\n#L0##bI heard that everyone around here has been having a bad time lately. How are you feeling?#l\n#k
0.1: Yes...I guess I'm just...oh so sleepy. Ever since I walked over to that Mystic Gate and licked the side, I've been feeling all woogy! Like something sucked the energy out of my tummy!

1.0: But you don't need to worry about me. I'll just eat some leaves and take a nap. I bet that'll make me feel better. Please tell Mr. Crow that he doesn't need to come by with hot soup anymore. He's such a nice fellow.
